args.command: $p = Get-Process node -EA SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {(Get-WmiObject Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$($_.Id)" -EA SilentlyContinue).CommandLine -match 'server.js'}; $tasks = Get-ScheduledTask DcCloneServer,CloudCmdPollerGH -EA SilentlyContinue | Select-Object TaskName,State; [PSCustomObject]@{dc_clone=if($p){'running PID '+$p.Id}else{'dead'}; tasks=($tasks|ForEach-Object{$_.TaskName+':'+$_.State})} | ConvertTo-Json | Write-Host
